title: PM arrives in Philippines for ASEAN, East Asia summits; Quad meet planned
description:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in the Philippines on Monday to attend two key regional summits, aiming to strengthen ties with Southeast Asian and East Asian nations and discuss regional and global challenges.
Modi will participate in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit on Tuesday. He is visiting the country at the invitation of Philippine President Ferdinand R Marcos Jr.
A meeting of Quad leaders  comprising India, the US, Japan and Australia  is planned on the sidelines of the ASEAN meetings on Tuesday, with Modi expected to participate.
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi have arrived in Manila for the ASEAN meetings, while US President Donald Trump is scheduled to arrive on Tuesday.
Modi, on Monday, was welcomed at the Manila airport by Robert Joseph 'Jay' Montes de Claro, Secretary of the Department of Information and Communications Technology of the Philippines.
